scope: Paired authored PiPER grip-guard pilot, privileged native state and synthetic rigid blocks. No learned policy, sensor pipeline, calibrated contact, shoe competence or physical robot qualification.

contract.scope: Authored PiPER rigid-block contact pilot with privileged native state. Pinned upstream servos/inertias/collision proxies/gravity compensation, synthetic commands and uncalibrated contact. No learned skill, camera sensing, shoe manipulation or physical robot qualification.

actions.joint_targets_rad: six native position-servo targets in radians
actions.gripper_position_m: one native single-finger slide target in metres [0,.035]; 0 closed/.035 open; not measured full gap

contract.tcp: authored site in link6 at local [0,0,.12003] near the distal finger-box centers; not hardware calibrated
contract.object: free rigid block with native gravity, no weld/equality/mocap or post-reset pose writes
contract.contact: stock native finger collision boxes; object priority1 authors pair friction explicitly
contract.servo_gains: unchanged upstream PiPER position servos and force caps; upstream robot gravcomp=1 retained
contract.collision_support_exemption: fixed base capsule may contact floor; moving robot/table/floor or block/nonfinger contacts are critical
contract.observations: privileged joint/object/TCP/contact state; no deployable sensor pipeline
contract.success: valid native physics, sustained bilateral table-free lift and retained carry to supported destination, then actual released/settled destination dwell and retreat

guard_contract.observations: grip check uses causal current privileged TCP/object pose and bilateral native contacts at 20 ms; no mass/friction or scorer input; downstream original motion policy remains unchanged and uses the existing lift outcome flag
guard_contract.qualification: slow 10 mm probe; object rises at least 6 mm, both pads retain contact, support is absent and TCP-local drift <=3 mm for 100 ms
guard_contract.alarm: two consecutive snapshots with relative drift, bilateral-contact loss or supported object failing to follow a moving probe; bounded closure/probe timeouts
guard_contract.recovery: hold measured six joint targets first; only supported objects may be opened/recentered/retried, at most once; support loss stops closed
guard_contract.stop: requested measured joint targets; native rate limiting and inertia may continue motion, which is recorded
guard_contract.duration: original fixed episode timeout including every probe/retry/abort holding command
guard_contract.scope: authored simulator controller, not a sensor implementation, hardware safety controller or learned policy

evaluation_contract.scope: Independent recorded 20ms boundary proxies, not recomputed native physics or classifier accuracy. Following requires table-free object rise and stable TCP-local object offset, without controller predicates. Unresolved decisions and absent opportunities remain explicit. Alarm delays use simulator timestamps; wall computation is reported separately. Post-alarm path includes native servo motion while holding.

timing_boundary: Attempt wall includes asset verification, compilation, settling, authored planning/IK, physics, contact scoring and recorded state construction. Protocol/report/trace disk serialization, rendering, training, physical sensing, transport and actuation are excluded. Control computation windows are not sensor-to-actuator reaction times.
comparison: Two shared XY layouts at each friction; identical native model per scene. Each placement has a separately matched open-jaw replay of its own complete valid requested-arm tape; common hold uses initial arm targets. Aborts retain the full timeout unless native physics becomes invalid. Invalid/incomplete placement leaves its dependent replay invalid; no tape extension.
split_note: Synthetic layouts; confirmation is a declaration, not proof of unseen scenes. Controller and evaluation thresholds are frozen before running, not accuracy estimates.
